data.segment_title: Campaign 2004 / Bush vs. Kerry / Republican Convention / Demonstrations
data.segment_description:
(Convention floor: Peter Jennings)  The standings of President Bush vs. Senator John Kerry on various issues in the latest ABC News/"Washington Post" poll outlined on screen. 
 (Convention floor: Kate Snow)  The opening day at the Republican National Convention in New York City featured; details given about Vice President Dick Cheney's appearance here.  [Senator Bill FRIST, black MAN, Speaker of the House Dennis HASTERT††, New York City Mayor Michael BLOOMBERG†, Representative Jim DeMINT†- promote Bush.]  Speeches tonight by former New York City Mayor Rudolph Giuliani & Senator John McCain previewed. 
 (Convention floor: Peter Jennings)  Report introduced. 
 (Taylor, Michigan: Terry Moran)  Bush's campaigning in New Hampshire featured; details given about his most recent statement on the war on terrorism.  [BUSH - speaks about an offensive campaign against terrorism.]  [In NBC interview, BUSH - says you cannot win "it," but can create conditions....]  [September 20, 2001, June 17, 2004, BUSH - says we will not falter & will not fail; states we will win the war on terror.] 
 (Convention floor: Peter Jennings)  Report introduced. 
 (New York: John Berman)  The demonstrations in New York City featured; scenes shown from the streets of various groups protesting against Bush.  [Michigan housewife Mikaela BRENNAN - comments.] 
 (Convention floor: Peter Jennings)  The spontaneity during the roll call of the states nominating Bush & Cheney presented; scenes shown of delegates from 21 states casting their votes.

data.segment_title: Campaign 2004 / Bush vs. Kerry / McCain Interview
data.segment_description: (New York: Peter Jennings)  Taped conversation with Senator John McCain just before the Republican National Convention presented.  [McCAIN&nbsp- says he is a friend of Senator John Kerry, but President Bush has proven to be a good president, but the nation is bitterly partisan; notes he is not the heir apparent of the Republican Party; comments on the Swift boat ads, the "fog of war" & Kerry's war decorations; says we could shut down the 527s & the dirty money; notes Kerry's activities after the Vietnam war are fair game, but his war record is not; reiterates Bush has already proven his leadership.]

The Money Trail (Convention Campaign Finances) Part I
data.segment_description:
(New York: Peter Jennings)  Report introduced. 
 (New York: Brian Ross)  Politics & money at the Republican National Convention featured; scenes shown of corporate lobbyists all over New York City to entertain powerful Republicans & their friends.  [Public Campaign Group Micah SIFRY†- comments on what happens.]  [Democracy 21 Fred WERTHEIMER†- comments on the excess.]  [Lobbyist/convention organizer David NORCROSS&nbsp- calls a conflict of interest "nonsense."]  [Former representative turned lobbyist Dick ARMEY&nbsp- explains why he is here.]
